newsitem.title: FRANCE: Coceral sees EU 96/97 soft wheat exports at 15 mln.
newsitem.headline: Coceral sees EU 96/97 soft wheat exports at 15 mln.

text.p: The Coceral grain trade organisation has provisionally set a 15 million tonnes target for European Union soft wheat grain and processed product exports in the 1996/97 season, European grain industry sources said on Thursday.
This would compare with exports of 12.1 million tonnes in 1995/96.

The Coceral draft will be submitted to members of the European Union's consultative committee meeting on Thursday and Friday, they said. The data may thus be fine-tuned before publication on Friday, they cautioned.
The draft estimate also suggests exports of EU barley grain and processed products may reach 8.3 million tonnes in 1996/97 against 4.5 million tonnes in 1995/96.
Coceral put total grain and processed products exports at 25.8 million tonnes against 19.3 million tonnes in the previous season.
The draft report also shows the European Union may end the 1996/97 season with a grain carryover of 34.4 million tonnes against 23.7 million at the end of 1995/96.
Coceral put the EU 96/97 soft wheat carryover at 11 million tonnes against 7.8 million tonnes in 95/96.
It targets a barley carryover of 8.8 million tonnes against 5.8 million tonnes in 1995/96 and a maize carryover of 10.2 million tonnes against 6.6 million tonnes.
Coceral is expected to maintain its December estimate of a EU grain crop at 203 million tonnes in 1996 against 175.8 million tonnes in 1995.
This would compare with a European Union estimate of 204.3 million tonnes, grain industry sources said.
The latest EU statistics show EU grain export commitments between July 1, 1996 and end January 1997 stood at 19 million tonnes.
Industry sources estimate that the EU still needs to export 6.8 million tonnes of grain before the end of 1996/97 season to meet Coceral's export goal of 25.8 million tonnes.
